newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX Hub natgas called little changed, cash holds.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX Hub natgas called little changed, cash holds.

text.p: NYMEX Henry Hub natgas futures were expected to open little changed Friday as the cash market rally halted ahead of the weekend, market sources said.
August over-the-counter trade ranged from $2.17 to $2.185 after settling Thursday at $2.175 per million British thermal units.
August, set to expire Tuesday, last traded on ACCESS a half cent firmer at $2.18.
Early Friday cash prices were talked at $2.22-2.24 at Henry Hub.
Chart traders said August resistance was at $2.21 and then at $2.29 and $2.36. Support was seen at $2.07 and then at the $2.051 low from July 8.
In Thursday's cash, Gulf Coast prices firmed four cents to the low-$2.20s. Midcon pipes were up about five cents to the mid-teens. New York city gate gas firmed a few cents to the low-to-mid $2.40s.

Warmer air moving into the East and Midwest will likely support cash in the near-term, traders said. Cooler weather is forecast to return by the middle of next week, according to Weather Services Corp.
